summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the ESC ] 0 ; title BEL format entry and Control.title(title), with a docstring. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor; it buffers the control only when is_terminal is true and returns that result, with the required docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a legacy dispatch branch that calls term.set_title(title) with the title from the control code. CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_console.py test_set_window_title (skipped on win32), test_control.py test_control_title, and test_windows_renderer.py test_control_set_window_title. Caveats: the Windows wrapper method is named set_title, which I used in place of the literal set-title. The Console test skips on sys.platform win32 rather than checking legacy_windows. Title text is passed through unsanitized, as specified. Nothing was executed, so Black formatting and test results are unverified.
